description: This Java class 'EchoServerInitializer' initializes Netty server channels for an echo server, configuring HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 pipelines, SSL, WebSocket handling, and error management.

classes.name: EchoServerInitializer
classes.description: A Netty ChannelInitializer that sets up the pipeline for an echo server supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, WebSocket, SSL, and error handling.

methods.name: initChannel
methods.description: Initializes the channel pipeline with handlers based on security and error configurations.

methods.name: configureHttp1Pipeline
methods.description: Configures the pipeline for HTTP/1.1 traffic, including codecs, decompression, aggregation, WebSocket, and custom handlers.

methods.name: configureHttp2Pipeline
methods.description: Configures the pipeline for HTTP/2 traffic, including connection, frame handling, and WebSocket support.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions caught during channel processing by logging and closing the context.
